steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Configure the core app metadata including the package name com.expensetracker.app and the app label in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Create the Gradle build script targetting Android SDK 34, using Java 8 compatibility configurations with AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Define Android Manifest
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml declaring standard permissions, light system theme, launcher activity MainActivity, and circular icon path configuration.

steps.title: Create Dashboard Shape Styles
steps.description: Create custom XML drawable shapes to render rounded-corner dashboard panels with elegant borders.

steps.title: Create Interactive Button Shape Styles
steps.description: Design sleek rounded button backgrounds to define prominent transaction actions.

steps.title: Create Circle Badge Base Shape
steps.description: Create a round oval background configuration to represent dynamic income/expense indicator badges.

steps.title: Design Main Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Implement a modular layout displaying active Month Switchers, net accounts summary cards, category budgets, and scrollable transactions.

steps.title: Design Dialog Transaction Layout
steps.description: Formulate a sleek, custom pop-up dialog inputting transaction type (Income/Expense), category selection, amount, note, and custom date pickers.

steps.title: Design Category Report Entry Layout
steps.description: Implement a sub-row design containing a Category Name label, spent metrics, and horizontal ProgressBars to output monthly shares.

steps.title: Design Custom Transaction Row Layout
steps.description: Implement transaction list items displaying initials in a dynamic colored circle, descriptions, relative dates, and formatted values.

steps.title: Implement Database Helper
steps.description: Construct standard local SQLite SQLiteOpenHelper classes for writing, reading, grouping, and safely wiping transactions data.

steps.title: Initialize View Elements and Default Data
steps.description: Link visual widgets in MainActivity and load standard initial mock accounts/data to populate tables gracefully on fresh installs.

steps.title: Implement Month Selector Actions
steps.description: Implement previous/next interactive state machines triggering calendar jumps and dynamic screen calculations automatically.

steps.title: Implement Interactive Dialog Prompts
steps.description: Build pop-up logic showing custom date triggers, toggling category spinner types, validating input values, and storing database structures.

steps.title: Render History and Monthly Summary Layouts
steps.description: Code custom inflation steps mapping database records to list row representations, colorizing amounts, and calculating category percentages.

steps.title: Validate Manifest Configuration
steps.description: Ensure the application namespace is correct and verify activity registry items for proper build generation.

steps.title: Building Expense Tracker
steps.description: Assemble and compile the built package using the Gradle 8.5 debug target profile successfully.
